name: Can I finance ground-up home construction?

mainEntity.name: Can I finance ground-up home construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, financing ground-up home construction typically involves a construction loan. This type of loan is structured differently from a traditional mortgage, with funds disbursed in stages as construction milestones are met. Once the home is complete, the construction loan is usually converted into or refinanced with a permanent mortgage. Lenders often require a detailed construction plan and budget.
